properties.name: app.version
properties.description: Application version injected by the Gradle release plugin at build time. Not bound to any @Value field — used for logging and monitoring only.

properties.name: cache-sync.job.enabled
properties.description: Enables or disables the CacheSyncJobScheduler. Consumed by @ConditionalOnProperty — not a @Value binding.

properties.name: app.data-provider
properties.description: Active data provider for batch imports. Consumed by @ConditionalOnProperty DefaultDataProvider or any custom implementation.

properties.name: app.ingestion.polling.fixed-delay
properties.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between BatchJobPollingScheduler executions. Consumed by @Scheduled(fixedDelayString).

properties.name: cache-sync.job.fixed-delay
properties.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between CacheSyncJobScheduler executions. Consumed by @Scheduled(fixedDelayString).
